$comment: Maps design.md to the M20 Design System pages in Confluence. Every `##` section of design.md must appear in exactly one page's `sections` (npm run check enforces it). `library: true` appends the generated asset catalog from cms/library.mjs. A page with `id: null` doesn't exist yet: the publishing agent creates it under the hub and writes its ID back here. See "Publishing the design system" in AGENTS.md.
